severityMeaning.error: The question has more than one defensible answer, a wrong answer, or a broken option — it must not be served as-is.
severityMeaning.warning: Defensible but weak: a borderline second answer, an inconsistency with the same word's other questions, or a junk option.

meta.notCovered: Structural rules (answer present, duplicate options, blank hides the word) are already enforced by src/utils/quizAudit.ts and pass on all 321 questions.

findings.note: 「小美是我的好朋友，她很友善。」is fully correct — 小美 is also a name.
名字 ('name') is a category, not a synonym of 友美. The question has no real answer.
「妳這個假期要做什麼？」is correct — 假期 fits the blank.
「我喜歡在假期睡懶覺。」is correct; 星期一/星期五 also fit.
假期 is the correct synonym here but a distractor in questions 7 and 8.
「妳這個週末要吃/喝/玩什麼？」are all correct — any transitive verb fits 要＿什麼.
findings.prompt: 友美，妳這個週末要＿＿＿什麼？

findings.note: 幹 is vulgar in Taiwanese Mandarin; unusable in an A1-A2 Traditional-Chinese course.
Every pronoun fits 「＿要在家看書、聽音樂。」
「他/她是你的朋友。」are both correct.
自己 = 'oneself', not a synonym of 我.
需要/必須/可以 all produce correct sentences.
想要/需要/必須 all fit; 想要 is a near-synonym of 要.
在 also translates as 'on' (在桌子上) — 'on' is defensible.
「我要在學校/公司/圖書館看書、聽音樂。」are all correct.
「我愛我的學校/公司。」are correct.
「我要在家看電影、聽音樂。」is correct.
「我喜歡＿。」accepts every option; the same stem appears at question 43 with a different answer.
「我要在家看書、看電視。」is correct.
Same stem as question 38 but a different 'correct' answer — proof the stem carries no constraint.
收聽 = 'tune in (to radio)', not a synonym of 聽音樂.
Nothing in the sentence picks a weekday — every 星期X fits.
findings.prompt: 我們這個＿＿＿下午兩點半去吧。

findings.note: 「星期一是我的休息日。」is correct.
六日 means 'Sat & Sun' (and is Mainland usage), not 星期六.
「我早上/晚上/中午有課。」are all correct.
有時間 is an exact synonym of 有空 — and is the declared correct synonym at question 59.
「我今天忙。」is acceptable colloquially.
一同 also means 'together'.
吃下午茶 is idiomatic in Taiwan — 吃 fits the blank.
findings.prompt: 我們一起去＿＿＿下午茶，怎麼樣？

findings.note: 茶會 = 'tea party', not 下午茶.
「很好！你想去哪裡？」and 「還可以！…」are both natural.
同意 is a verb; 好啊 is an interjection — not interchangeable.
好吧 also means 'okay'.
「我/他/她想去哪裡？」are all correct.
Every pronoun fits; same stem as questions 18 and 133 with three different answers.
妳 is the feminine form of the same word 'you' — identical meaning and sound.
「你可以去哪裡？」and 「你要去哪裡？」are correct.
想要 fits and is the declared synonym at question 89.
「你想回哪裡？」is acceptable.
往 and 赴 both mean 'to go (to)'.
「我＿了。」is too short to constrain the answer; 不明白了 is possible.
曉得 means 'know' — and is the declared synonym at question 104.
「我知道一家很不錯的餐廳/商店。」are correct.
「我喜歡去餐廳/商店。」are correct.
雪糕 also means ice cream — declared the synonym at question 114.
「我愛吃冰棒/雪糕。」are correct.
冰糕 also denotes ice cream in some regions.
「…冰淇淋很一般。」is correct; also 很+很難吃 renders as 「很很難吃」.
findings.prompt: 我知道一家很不錯的咖啡廳，那裡的冰淇淋很＿＿＿。

findings.note: Option 「不 ngon」 is corrupted — Vietnamese leaked into the Chinese option.
「他們有草莓/芒果冰淇淋嗎？」are all correct.
「我愛吃餅乾/蛋糕/糖果。」are correct.
「有哦！」is natural Taiwanese Mandarin.
findings.prompt: 有＿＿＿！他們有很多種冰淇淋。

findings.note: 「哦，我明白了。」is the more natural sentence of the two.
哦 is the correct synonym here but a distractor at questions 127-128.
哦 also renders as 'ah/oh'.
「我們/你/我有很多種冰淇淋。」are all correct.
「你們/它們是我的朋友。」are correct.
它們 is 'they (inanimate)' — not a synonym of 他們 for people.
她們 and 它們 both translate as 'they'.
「我有一些書。」is correct.
大量 also reads as 'many/a large amount'.
類 also means 'kind/type'.
Nothing fixes the time — 三點/四點/五點 all fit.
findings.prompt: 我們這個星期六下午＿＿＿去吧。

findings.note: 「我們一點/三點見面。」are all correct.
兩點半 is ambiguous between 2:30 am and pm; '下午2:30' over-specifies.
Any male given name fits the blank.
findings.prompt: ＿＿＿說謝謝。他走去捷運站。他很高興。

findings.note: 名字 ('name') is not a synonym of 承翰.
「承翰要去圖書館/醫院/公司。」are all correct.
findings.prompt: 承翰要去＿＿＿。他不知道捷運站在哪裡

findings.note: 巴士站 is a real station — 「請問，巴士站在哪裡？」is correct.
公車站/火車站/計程車站 all exist and fit.
「他走去公車站/火車站/港口。」are all correct.
findings.prompt: 承翰說謝謝。他走去＿＿＿。他很高興。

findings.note: 車站 is the declared synonym at question 171 but a wrong option here.
「承翰要來學校。」is correct.
findings.prompt: 承翰要＿＿＿學校。他不知道捷運站在哪裡

findings.note: 曉得 = 知道 and 記得 both give grammatical sentences; the stem shows no clue that he does NOT know.
findings.prompt: 承翰要去學校。他＿＿＿捷運站在哪裡

findings.note: 不知 also means 'do not know'.
請問 means 'excuse me / may I ask', not the imperative 'please ask' — the authored gloss drives every option here.
「對不起，捷運站在哪裡？」and 「不好意思，…」are natural.
詢問 is a formal verb, not interchangeable with the opener 請問.
詢問 is the declared synonym at question 184 but a wrong option here.
站在 is a mis-split of 捷運站 + 在. The word does not exist in the sentence and 'is located at' is not what 站在 means.
Teaches the wrong parse: the sentence is 捷運站 / 在 / 哪裡, not 捷運 / 站在 / 哪裡.
位於 and 位在 both fit 「捷運＿那裡」— and inherit the 站在 segmentation error.
位於 is the correct synonym here but a distractor at question 189.
Any female given name fits.
名字 is not a synonym of 婉婷.
「捷運站在這裡/左邊/右邊」are all correct.
哪裡 is the question word 'where'; 那裡 is 'there'. They are not synonyms.
那邊 and 那兒 both mean 'there'.
「近嗎？」「快嗎？」are all valid questions — the one-word stem constrains nothing.
遙遠 means 'far' — and is the declared synonym at question 202.
「遠吧？」is grammatical.
呢 and 嗎 are different particles; 呢 cannot replace 嗎 in a yes/no question.
不遠處 / 不遠的 are morphological variants meaning 'not far'.
很近的 is the same word with a particle; not a genuine alternative.
「承翰說對不起/抱歉/不好意思。」are all correct.
findings.prompt: 承翰說＿＿＿。他走去捷運站。他很高興。

findings.note: 「他跑去捷運站。」is correct.
findings.prompt: 承翰說謝謝。他＿＿＿去捷運站。他很高興。

findings.note: 行 also means 'to walk'.
「他很難過/悲傷/失望。」are all grammatical; the stem gives no emotional cue.
findings.prompt: 承翰說謝謝。他走去捷運站。他很＿＿＿。

findings.note: 高興劑 is not a word.
Every weekday fits 「我＿有課，所以不能去玩。」
週五 is Friday.
「早上/中午/下午我要去看電視。」are all correct.
傍晚 = 'dusk', which is a wrong option for this same word at question 232.
夜晚 also renders as 'evening/night'.
王大/李小 are names and fit the blank.
名字 is not a synonym of 志豪.
「我回學校/公司了，很高興。」are correct.
屋 is not used alone in Mandarin, and 家 (home) ≠ 屋 (house).
李美/王小 are names and fit the blank.
名字 is not a synonym of 佳玲.
一同 and 一齊 both mean 'together'; 一起子 is not a word.
Every weekday fits 「＿我要去逛街。」
週六 is Saturday.
做 also means 'create/make' — 'create' is defensible.
幹 is vulgar in Taiwanese Mandarin.
妳 is the same word as 你 (feminine form), and is used as a wrong option at question 273.
妳 means 'you'; 汝 is the classical 'you'.
「我生病，謝謝你的關心。」is acceptable.
臺北/高雄/臺中夜市 all fit 「我們去＿吃小吃。」
「這個東西很不好吃，我很喜歡。」is odd but grammatical.
好棒 = 'great', a degree stronger than 好.
牛排/豬排/魚排 all fit 「我愛吃＿，很好吃。」
炸雞 = 'fried chicken', not specifically 雞排.
很吃 and 吃得 are not words — the option set gives the answer away.
好極了 also means 'great'.
「我愛喝紅茶/綠茶/咖啡，很好喝。」are all correct.
泡茶 means 'to brew tea', not bubble tea (珍奶 / 波霸奶茶).
有 does mean 'exist' (有 = there is) — 'exist' is a correct answer.
Option 沒有錢 renders the sentence as 「我沒有錢錢，可以買東西。」
有的 means 'some', not 'have'.
「你們/他們/她們是朋友，很好。」are all correct.
我們自己 contains the prompt word — it is 'ourselves', not a synonym.
七點/八點/九點 all fit.
六時 is 'six o'clock' — and is the declared synonym at question 312.
「我們在火車站/巴士站/港口見面。」are all correct.
「我們六點在捷運站走。」is marginally acceptable.
視 also means 'to see' (literary).
